title: Daily compliance sprint notes
content:
Quick morning sprint log — consolidation of small TODOs, notes, and things to bring up in 1:1 with Liam.

Goals for today:
- Finish evidence pull for user provisioning (IAM screenshots) for SOC2 control AC-1.
- Kick off vendor questionnaire for LogBridge (SaaS monitoring provider).
- Draft first pass of '3.4 Data retention' policy edits to align with Dedicated deployment SLA.

Status snapshot:
- IAM evidence: partial. Downloaded admin-role activity csv from GCP console (SEC-412). Need to redact service account keys. Estimated 60m.
- Access review: have last quarterly attestation spreadsheet, but missing updated sign-offs from infra team (Sofia). Pinged via slack #infra-ops.
- Vendor list: added LogBridge, SecuVault, and DocuKeep to the intake sheet. LogBridge questionnaires bookmarked under Confluence link above.

Immediate checklist (today) [timebox estimates]:
[ ] Redact service account keys from iam-activity-2025-11.csv (60m)
[ ] Upload redacted csv to evidence bucket + link in Confluence page (15m)
[ ] Prepare vendor risk starter email for LogBridge (include SIG, encryption, subprocessors) (30m)
[ ] Quick call with Sofia to get infra sign-offs (15m)
[ ] Add policy snippet for retention policy with explicit retention periods for logs (draft) (45m)

Notes to self and friction points:
- Evidence filenames are messy across drives: standardize to YYYYMMDD-control-action-owner. Make a small script later to rename. Add as task.
- When redacting, keep a copy of original in locked folder (for auditors) and only upload redacted copy to shared evidence page. 
- Need confirmation on whether dedicated customers count as separate tenant for log retention policy (product question). Add to product-ops backlog (COM-78).

Vendor: LogBridge quick watchlist:
- Prelim answers: TLS 1.2+, offers customer-managed keys (KMIP/HSM), subprocessors list not fully populated.
- Qs to send in starter email: 1) Can you provide SOC2 Type II report? 2) Data residency options per region? 3) Subprocessor list + contracts? 4) Encryption at rest key rotation policy?
- Risk rating (quick): medium until SOC2 and subprocessors confirmed. Tag for follow-up with procurement.

Policy TODOs (short drafts):
- Data Retention (sec-logs): propose 90d for request logs, 365d for audit logs, 7y for billing records.
- Vendor Onboarding: add step to require 'subprocessors csv' and 'support SLA' before approving non-prod access.
- Incident Response: ensure playbook references dedicated vs hosted fallback routes (WhoIsRunbook v2).

Blocked / asks:
- Blocked on product clarity re: dedicated customer separation for retention. (Assigned: Liam)
- Need access to procurement folder to attach vendor contract samples (Sofia).

Quick meeting notes 2026-03-10 09:30 sync with Security team:
- Sofia: will get infra attestation by EOD Friday.
- Liam: will confirm dedicated tenant semantics with product-ops.
- Action: I will draft email to LogBridge and add vendor to procurement queue.

Small automation ideas (follow-up backlog):
- One-click evidence bundler: collect files by control tag and zip + generate Confluence link. (low effort, high reuse)
- Filename normalizer script (python) that inserts control tag and date.

Random reminders (personal):
- Bring up auditor access window for next week (Tuesday preferred).
- Update 'evidence index' on Confluence to include cross-links to jira tickets.

End of entry — quick wins planned for next 48 hours:
1) Redact + upload IAM evidence.
2) Draft and send LogBridge questionnaire.
3) Start retention policy snippet and share for first review.

Open questions to resolve:
- Do we require signed subprocessors list before procurement approval or is a written statement acceptable? (policy team)
- What is the expected retention for GPU job metadata under Dedicated? (infra/product)

-- Asha
